notes: Format-faithful synthetic PatentSearch API response pair (page 1 full, page 2 short/final) for a grant-date range query, paged via the assumed 'after' cursor on ascending patent_id. Exercises: a mapped assignee by exact name (Microsoft Corporation -> MSFT), an unmapped assignee (Example Innovations Inc.), an unassigned patent (empty assignees array, name stays null), a multi-assignee patent (first-listed organization wins the display name, assigneeCount keeps the total of 2), a second CPC entry that is ignored in favor of the first, and a second mapped assignee by exact name after suffix-stripping (International Business Machines Corporation -> IBM).
